chapter.heading: Thanksgiving to God for His Enduring Mercy
chapter.v:
Oh, give
thanks to the Lord, for He is good!For His mercy endures forever.

Oh, give
thanks to the God of gods!For His mercy endures forever. [Jer. 17:20]

Oh, give
thanks to the Lord of lords!For His mercy endures forever: [Is. 58:6; Jer. 21:12; [Mic. 6:8]; Zech. 7:9; 8:16; Matt. 23:23 c Jer. 7:6; Zech. 7:10]

To Him
who made great lights,For His mercy endures forever— [Is. 37:24 h Jer.]

The moon
and stars to rule by night,For His mercy endures forever. [2 Kin. 22:17; 2 Chr. 34:25; Jer.]

With a
strong hand, and with an outstretched arm,For His mercy endures forever;

And made
Israel pass through the midst of it,For His mercy endures forever;

To Him
who led His people through the wilderness,For His mercy endures forever;

And slew
famous kings,For His mercy endures forever— [Jer. 16:4, 6 t 1 Kin. 13:30]

And Og
king of Bashan,For His mercy endures forever—

A heritage
to Israel His servant,For His mercy endures forever.

Who gives
food to all flesh,For His mercy endures forever. [2 Kin. 24:15, 16; Jer. 34:20]

Oh, give
thanks to the God of heaven!For His mercy endures forever. [2 Kin. 24:15; Jer. 10:18; 16:13]
